text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — legal + security review needed for the marketplace listing narrative and the joint announcement with SI/hardware partner. We plan to announce next Mon (tentative). Need: the exact approved SOC2 statement, a short pen-test summary line, and a list of artifacts we can include publicly. Can legal/security confirm by EOD Fri? cc @Connor @Priya @Aisha :pray:

Connor Blake: On it. Please drop the current draft narrative here and a proposed artifact list. Also need to know if there are any embargo constraints from the partner side (NDAs). We should avoid definitive language about SOC scope unless the report explicitly states it.

Maya Chen: Draft pasted below — please edit for legal-safe language. Artifact list proposal: 1) SOC2 attestation cover page (redacted), 2) pen-test executive summary (redacted), 3) architecture diagram (public version), 4) SI integration checklist (non-sensitive). Partner already signed a mutual NDA last quarter per Marco.

Priya Nair: Security note — pen-test exec summary is ok but redact hostnames/IPs, internal creds, and low-level logs. We can include a one-paragraph findings summary and CVSS rollup. For SOC2, ask partner for the short attestation blurb (we can't assert they were in scope for specific controls). Suggested phrasing: "Partner maintains SOC2 Type II attestation for security controls; attestations available upon request under NDA."

Marco Ruiz: Confirmed NDA exists (signed 2024-05-10). Partner legal asked for a 48h review once you share the public narrative. Timeline: we need final copy to partner by Fri AM to hit Monday announce.

Aisha Patel: I'll own artifact packaging + presign links. Plan: gather artifacts, scrub sensitive bits, pre-sign S3 objects with 7-day expiry, and provide a manifest. Please add owners for each artifact (we need one owner per item).

Sam Lee: For the presign step, here's the quick command we use:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-internal/marketplace/partnerX/soc-attestation.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

Sam Lee: Also — do not upload logs or raw screenshots to the public bundle. If you need examples, create redacted PDFs.

Connor Blake: Legal edits (high level): 1) Replace any absolute uptime/capacity claims with "subject to partner attestations and SLA terms." 2) Replace specific SOC control references with generic attestation language. 3) Add embargo clause: "This announcement is embargoed until 2024-06-17 09:00 PT; distribution prior to that requires written approval from both parties." I can draft a short approval checklist.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Connor — can you drop the edited narrative + checklist by Thu EOD so we can iterate with partner Fri AM?

Priya Nair: One more security ask: include a pointer to our public security page rather than detailed control text. Link: https://redwood.ai/security (public).

artifact-bot: Uploaded: partnerX_architecture_public_v1.pdf (owner: Marco Ruiz)

Aisha Patel: Owners so far — SOC attestation: Marco; Pen-test summary: Priya; Arch diagram: Marco; SI checklist: Aisha. I'll create the manifest and share presigns by Fri noon.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — if we can get sign-off by Fri noon from legal + partner, we should be green for Mon. :thumbsup:

Connor Blake: Will try to get final legal sign-off by Fri noon. If partner requests heavier redaction we'll ask for an exemption and escalate.

Priya Nair: I'll review the pen summary tomorrow morning and confirm redactions.

Marco Ruiz: Looping in partner PM after Connor's edits.

Maya Chen: Great — closing loop here. If anyone hits blockers DM me.
